persons.name: Usama bin Ladin
persons.role: Leader of the 'Islamic Army', whose Shora Council is the subject of the report

mentions.quote: THE SHORA COUNCIL OF USAMA ( (BIN LADIN) ) 'S ISLAMIC ARMY CONSISTED OF A VARIETY OF MEMBERS

organizations.name: Islamic Army
organizations.notes: The report says it includes participants from Islamic extremist groups or cells worldwide. Those groups also operate autonomously.

organizations.name: Islamic Army Shora Council
organizations.notes: Its members represent Islamic extremist groups or cells worldwide. The member names and biographies are not legible in this chunk.

events.description: CIA information report issued on the responsibilities and backgrounds of the Islamic Army Shora Council members. It is not finally evaluated intelligence.
CIA information report disseminated on the responsibilities and background of Islamic Army Shora Council members; the council includes representatives of Islamic extremist groups or cells worldwide.

relationships.detail: The Shora Council is the council of bin Ladin's Islamic Army.
relationships.quote: THE SHORA COUNCIL OF USAMA ( (BIN LADIN) ) 'S ISLAMIC ARMY

relationships.detail: The Islamic Army is described as bin Ladin's.
The Shora Council is described as belonging to bin Ladin's Islamic Army, i.e. it is his council.
relationships.quote: THE SHORA COUNCIL OF USAMA ((BIN LADIN))'S ISLAMIC ARMY CONSISTED OF A VARIETY OF MEMBERS

relationships.detail: The report's country line is Sudan/International, associating the subject with Sudan.

key_claims: The Shora Council of bin Ladin's Islamic Army consisted of members representing Islamic extremist groups or cells worldwide.
These groups operate both autonomously and as Islamic Army participants.
